para.dtcname: Door Glass Does Not Close Fully During AUTO UP Operation (Jam Protection Function Operates)

test1.ptxt: While the power window at the location where the jam protection function operates is moving, disconnect the power window regulator motor assembly (relevant seat) connector or disconnect the cable from the negative battery terminal to put the power window regulator motor assembly (relevant seat) in the uninitialized state.
Perform the registration settings for the power window regulator motor assembly (ECU) at the location where the jam protection function operates. (see )
Open and close the power window at the location where the jam protection function operates, and check that it operates normally.

testgrp.testtitle: Inspect Door Glass Sliding Resistance (Location where Jam Protection Function Operates)

test1.ptxt: Assemble the door glass to the door sash, raise it by hand and check that it slides smoothly without catching.

item.ptxt: The door glass should not contact the glass run unnaturally.
The glass run should be free of deformation and trapped foreign matter.

testgrp.testtitle: Replace Power Window Regulator Motor Assembly (Location Where Jam Protection Function Operates)
End (Registration Setting Malfunction Was the Cause)
Install Correctly (Repair or Replace Trapped Foreign Matter or Improper Installation Causing Poor Fit)
